properties.title: EndoWAM: A Grounded World-Action Model for Generalizable Endoscopic Navigation

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: World action model for robotic endoscope navigation with future-target grounding, evaluated by closed-loop trials on three physical phantoms.

Video DiT initialised from Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B with LoRA, a transformer discrete action decoder and a Grounding DiT reading one shared intermediate representation, deployed on a three-DoF flexible endoscope.

properties.algorithm: Single-pass video flow-matching representation with action decoder and future-target Grounding DiT

properties.population: anatomical phantoms for ureteroscopy, esophagoscopy and ERCP
properties.decision: three-DoF endoscope motion toward an instructed target

properties.description: 32 closed-loop trials on a ureteroscopy phantom with randomly sampled initial viewpoints and roll offsets
32 closed-loop trials on an esophagoscopy phantom
32 closed-loop trials on an ERCP phantom
96 trials pooled over the three procedures
Six unseen environment and target shift conditions with 32 trials each
Closed-loop physical phantom trials for baselines, variants, ablations and zero-shot shifts

properties.algorithm: Qwen3DiT (Qwen3-VL-2B backbone with diffusion transformer action head)
Qwen3AE (Qwen3-VL-2B backbone with the discrete action expert)

relation_assertions.rationale: A learned decision policy built on a world-model representation is run in closed loop on a physical environment. No uncertainty, treatment-effect or sim-to-real claim is made, so G04, G06 and G10 are not selected.

capability_assessments.rationale: Downgraded from L4 to not_world_model under the ontology core-identity rule: although EndoWAM trains a video DiT with future-target latent grounding (L_video + L_ground) and deploys a closed-loop discrete action policy on physical phantoms (planning.search_policy and evaluation.E9 evaluated in 32 trials per procedure), Eq. (1) and Section 3.2 compute a fresh single-pass denoising representation from only the current observation o_t and instruction l at each step without carrying a persistent evolving state across control steps (state.persistent is partial/not met), future-frame decoding and Grounding DiT are dropped at inference, and predicted future latents are never evaluated. Thus core world-model identity is not met and EndoWAM is retained as a supporting component / world-action policy.

gate_assessments.rationale: The dataset is collected on phantoms and pseudo-labelled, test viewpoints are offset from training angles, but the split unit and separation of trajectories and phantoms between training and test are not stated, and the annotation appendix is not in the PDF.
The predicted future latent is never scored against a reference, so transition quality has no reported evidence.
A single future latent is predicted in one denoising pass, so more than one prediction time is not claimed.
No alternative actions are compared and no action support is analysed.
Closed-loop success is reported against five policies, but no test of model-error exploitation exists and the contribution of the dynamics prior is not isolated from backbone and pretraining.
No guard, abstention or escalation is described in the text read.

legacy_cells.B: EndoWAM: A Grounded World-Action Model for Generalizable Endoscopic Navigation
legacy_cells.C: Lin, Jinsong, Pan, Zikang, Liu, Wanhao, Ng, Chi Kit, Shao, Liangjing, Yu, Zihang, et al.
legacy_cells.O: Ureteroscopy, esophagoscopy, and endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP)
legacy_cells.S: Can the policy guide the flexible endoscope to an instructed target and keep it in view during closed-loop navigation?
legacy_cells.V: Three-degree-of-freedom endoscope movement toward instructed anatomical targets.
legacy_cells.AJ: Video DiT with a text encoder and video VAE; transformer action decoder; Grounding DiT
legacy_cells.AM: Language instructions are injected into DiT tokens by cross-attention; shared predictive representation H conditions both action and grounding heads.
legacy_cells.BD: Three-DoF endoscope control; target-center offset relative to the endoscopic view is converted to discrete action labels; no units stated.
legacy_cells.BH: Target-center offset relative to the endoscopic view is converted into discrete action labels for endoscope control.
legacy_cells.BS: Grounding DiT reconstructs VAE latents of target crops in future frames during training; this branch is dropped at inference.
legacy_cells.BT: Action decoder predicts per-axis categorical action logits; Grounding DiT reconstructs future target-region latents.
legacy_cells.BV: Weighted action cross-entropy, video rectified-flow velocity regression, and future-target latent denoising; total loss is their weighted sum.
legacy_cells.CB: 7.5 Hz closed-loop control frequency on one NVIDIA RTX 5090.
legacy_cells.DQ: 515 trajectories and 0.98M frames; after viewpoint augmentation: 4,120 sequences and 7.84M frames.
legacy_cells.EC: Closed-loop success: 77/96 trials (80.2%) overall; 90.6% ureteroscopy, 56.3% esophagoscopy, 93.8% ERCP. Zero-shot unseen-environment/target average: 90.1%.
legacy_cells.EG: 7.5 Hz control frequency on one NVIDIA RTX 5090; reported 6.8× faster than Cosmos Policy (1.1 Hz).
legacy_cells.EI: Table 1 average closed-loop success: Diffusion Policy 2.1%, Qwen3DiT 8.3%, π0.5 15.6%, Qwen3AE 17.7%, GR00T-N1.7 27.1%; EndoWAM 80.2%.
legacy_cells.EK: Removing Grounding DiT reduced average success from 80.2% to 37.5%; removing viewpoint augmentation reduced it to 28.1%. Grounding variants: CG 45.8%, FG-Gen 51.0%, EG 61.5% average success.
legacy_cells.EL: Lumen loss, wall impaction, or timeout.
legacy_cells.FL: A pretrained video DiT predicts future visual latents from current endoscopic observation and instruction. Its intermediate representation is shared by a discrete action decoder and a future-target Grounding DiT; at inference, the policy outputs action chunks and is deployed in closed loop.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces EndoWAM, which uses future target-region grounding from a predictive video representation to condition endoscopic navigation actions, and introduces the EndoMotion dataset.
legacy_cells.FN: On physical phantoms, EndoWAM achieved 80.2% average closed-loop success across three procedures and 90.1% average success under tested unseen environment/target shifts; reported control frequency was 7.5 Hz.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors identify that existing learning-based policies commonly predict actions from current observations without explicitly modelling future environment/anatomical dynamics.

notes:
World action model for flexible endoscope navigation. A Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B video DiT adapted with LoRA predicts a future latent in one denoising pass, and a discrete action decoder and a Grounding DiT read its intermediate features, trained on EndoMotion (515 teleoperated phantom trajectories, 4,120 sequences after rotation). Closed-loop success on three physical phantoms is 80.2 percent against 27.1 percent for the best baseline, 32 trials per procedure, and 90.1 percent on six zero-shot shifts. Classified L4 and a supporting component. Source points: the future prediction is never evaluated, the dynamics prior is not isolated from backbone and pretraining, no carried state or search, single values without intervals, pseudo-labelled targets, and appendices missing from the PDF.
